changelog: App dimming no longer creates an extra window; navigation labels retain native insets and per-tab colors have a color wheel and palettes.
Home provider icons can use provider artwork or the installed extension catalog; episode thumbnail masking follows recycled images.
Minibar resume and supported player controls use native playback calls; optional watched thresholds commit native state on player exit.
Download settings reflect native concurrency values; unsupported format and telemetry controls are clearly identified.
Settings transfers validate primitive types and preserve local security state; watch-party transport is hardened.
PIN storage, protected settings changes and the optional player time guard are strengthened.
System cleanup uses native operations with verification, device layouts restore cleanly, and community QA has a compact expandable view.
ATTENTION: Device playback and rendering still require verification. Parental controls are app-level assistance, not an OS-level lock.
Some quiet traces still wait to be found.
message: v730 - dimming, navigation, playback and safer settings
